`teach` is a bundled Consuelo OS skill. Builds a focused learning lesson from a chosen or seeded topic, optionally ingests research, renders a guide, publishes it through Sites, and can update teaching state.

## When to use it

Invoke when the user asks to teach, learn one idea, run Daily Deep Idea, create an AI learning guide, explain a paper/source as a durable lesson, or set up/swap an auto-teaching topic queue.

Typical requests include:

- “Teach me one deep idea about retrieval today.”
- “Turn this paper into a durable lesson and publish the guide.”

## Enable it

```bash
consuelo add skill teach
```

Run `consuelo add skill` without a name to choose from the skills that are not currently selected. Remove it with:

```bash
consuelo remove skill teach
```

## What the agent loads

The installed metadata points to `skills/teach/SKILL.md` in the immutable OS runtime. The compact steering catalog advertises the active skill by name and description; the full `SKILL.md` body is loaded only when the workflow applies.

Metadata for this skill currently declares permission `guidance` and `requiresApproval: no`. Those fields describe the skill contract; individual tools called by the skill still enforce their own authorization and safety rules.

## Boundary

Teach owns lesson orchestration and content. Sites owns the reader/delivery UI, and Research Ingest owns durable source ingestion.

## Verify

After enabling it, confirm `~/Consuelo/Skills/teach/SKILL.md` exists and that `teach` appears in `<CONSUELO_HOME>/components/installed-skills.json`. A newly bootstrapped agent should then see `teach` in the Installed skills portion of steering.
